description: This file defines the class 'jiraCommons', which contains utility methods for interacting with Jira issues, including checking bug ID existence, parsing dates, building HTML strings for statuses and summaries, and initializing default resolved statuses. It appears to be part of an issue tracking integration within the TestLink project.

classes.name: jiraCommons
classes.description: Provides utility functions for Jira issue integration, such as validation, date parsing, and formatting issue information.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a given issue ID exists in the Jira system.

methods.name: helperParseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string and formats it for display.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Builds an HTML string representing the status code, with optional decoration based on configuration.

methods.name: buildSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Creates a summary string for an issue, including its due date if available.

methods.name: initDefaultResolvedStatus
methods.description: Initializes a list of resolved statuses based on the provided status domain.
